extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF text, figures, and Table 2 monolayer data; mechanism strength is bounded to observed membrane interaction/perturbation evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The MreB-derived peptides interact more strongly with anionic bacterial-model lipid monolayers than neutral POPC monolayers, supporting membrane-binding propensity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Monolayer interaction supports membrane affinity but is not by itself a killing mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FESEM morphology after peptide treatment supports membrane perturbation as a killing mechanism for tested bacteria and fungus.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: reported peptides at minimum lethal concentrations

source_locator.note: Results/discussion prose states membrane perturbation interpretation.

mechanism_claims.limitations: No intracellular molecular target was directly assayed; mechanism is membrane perturbation/permeabilization, not a specific target-pathway claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill assays show rapid microbe killing at minimum lethal concentrations and support the membrane-perturbation interpretation as phenotypic evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: all four MreB-derived peptides across tested microbes
